body:
Merged main to resolve conflicts. The conflict tick stopped on these, but both sides compose rather than clash.

- **Posts, opening comment (fanuc, fanuc-lathe, haas, mazak, sinumerik, tormach):** this PR states the document's program comment, and main's #594 cleans the machine name. The resolution takes the program comment first (`progComment()` is already cleaned), else `clean(nm)`, else `CAMCRAFT`.
  - Fanuc, fanuc-lathe, Haas and Mazak keep this PR's O-word.
  - Sinumerik keeps this PR's MPF header and `PROGRAM n - …` line.
  - Tormach's `headTitle` now cleans the name and goes through main's `note()`.
- **`posting.rs` modules, `mcp_setup.rs` gate map and tests:** keep both.

Targeted gate:
- app: lib 103, `mcp_setup` 3, `conformance` 6, `fanuc_post` 11, `posting` 23, `golden_cl` 4, `tormach_post` 7, `comment_escape` 5, `program_comments` 17, `lathe_post` 13, `probe_dialects` 7, `probe_tormach` 4, `heidenhain_block_form` 9, `program_entry` 9, `project_roundtrip` 71, `tormach_machines` 3, and the safe-retract suites: all green.
- `camcraft-post` is all green.
- clippy `-D warnings` on the app lib + `mcp_setup`: clean.

One file: `crates/app/src/posting_per_op.rs`, where both sides changed the same program-number derivation - your branch resolves the document's program id through `document_program_id`/setup/effective-post, main numbers ops from the index (`u32::try_from(index)`). Main took project version v59 for #1056 in the meantime, so this PR's program key moves to v60 (PROJECT_VERSION, the version comments, the decision note and the version guard in tests/program_info.rs); the migration ladder needs no new rewrite. Targeted gate: camcraft-app test build ok; program_info 9, mcp_setup 9, per_op_files 9, setup_post_options 10, project_roundtrip 73, fidelity_copies 6, one_wcs 8 passed; clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings clean. Merge-time refresh by the maintainer's merging session; a review of the refreshed head follows.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (review of head ee50099, trial-merged with current main 5a37b737; the PR is a draft and I left that as it is).

**What looks good**
- Refresh check: the merged tree differs from origin/main only in the PR's own 33 files (no main-side file dropped or reverted). `PROJECT_VERSION` is 60 in `project/file.rs`, with the doc/comment in `project/mod.rs` and the decision note agreeing. The v59 ladder rung from #1056 (`fidelity_migrate::settle`) is intact and the v59 -> v60 note sits beside it in `apply.rs`.
- Round trip: `program` is `skip_serializing_if` none, so a document that states nothing writes no key; a stated number/comment round-trips (`the_program_info_round_trips_and_an_older_file_states_none`). A file older than v60 steps up with nothing stated and overwrites a stale in-memory value. A hand-edited bad value is refused as a corrupt file before any world write, by the same rules `SetProgramInfo` runs.
- Prime Directive: number 1..=9999 and comment (<=40 printable ASCII, no `( ) % ; *`) refused by name at command creation. `program_id` refuses a per-op count past O9999 rather than wrapping. `fanuc.cps` no longer clamps a bad number onto 9999 - it throws by name. SINUMERIK refuses a program name its rules forbid instead of renaming it. No unwrap/expect/panic in the new non-test code.
- Undoable `SetProgramInfo` (invert restores prev), with the `set_program` MCP tool. Layering and schema placement are right (`ProgramInfo` in `schema.rs`). Post-side `ProgramId` lives in camcraft-post. Provenance lines present, no new crate dependency lines.
- The hand-resolved `mcp/setup_tools.rs`, `posting.rs`, `posting_mounts.rs`, `posting_per_op.rs` read correctly: all three post paths (single, per-mount, per-op) now take the id from `document_program_id`.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| post: lib + post_engine, script_{fanuc,fanuc_lathe,haas,heidenhain,mazak,sinumerik,tormach}, fanuc_post, heidenhain_block_form, recorded_streams, comment_escape | all pass (39+33+11+15+11+11+11+11+12+5+12+3) |
| app: lib 154, program_info 9, project_roundtrip 73, mcp_setup 9, mcp 19, posting 17, per_op_files 9, setup_mounts_post 8, program_comments 4, setup_post_options 10, commands_undo 30, tormach_post 10 | all pass |
| ui lib (from crates/ui) | 643 passed, 5 ignored |
| clippy -D warnings, post + app + ui, all targets | clean |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The round-trip test steps up from a v58 file; a literal v59 fixture would pin the "main's v59 still loads" claim more directly. v59 goes through the same ladder, and I did not find a gap.
- `PROJECT_VERSION` bump is a format change; the title is `feat(post)` and the changelog/Fixes lines should stay as the author wrote them (no CHANGELOG edit in the diff, good).
- Several `.cps` files and `posting_program.rs` are fine on size; no snapshot PNG or golden changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The review of this head is clean. Before this merges the maintainer asks for before/after screenshots of the changed page in the PR description (in the description only, never snapshot PNGs in the branch). Labels stay as they are.

**Merged upstream/main** (96c1ded3, which includes #981, #1126, #759, #1369 and others) into `issue/258-program-number`. Plain merge, no rebase or force. The new head is **1676ad9e**:
- `bd102f4c`: the merge;
- `1676ad9e`: a follow-up test for inch programs.

`git show --remerge-diff bd102f4c --stat`:
```
 assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps         |  7 -------
 crates/app/src/posting.rs            |  9 +--------
 crates/app/src/posting_mounts.rs     |  6 +-----
 crates/app/src/project/apply.rs      |  2 +-
 crates/app/src/project/file.rs       | 17 +++++++----------
 crates/app/src/project/mod.rs        |  2 +-
 crates/app/tests/program_info.rs     | 12 +++++++++---
 docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md             | 22 +++++++++-------------
 docs/decisions/258-program-number.md |  9 ++++++---
 9 files changed, 35 insertions(+), 51 deletions(-)
```

**Version change: the project file goes to v61.** #981 took v60 for the unit law (#902). #258's `program` key still needs its own version step, because an older reader would drop the key and post O0001, which could overwrite another program on the control. So:
- `PROJECT_VERSION` is now 61, and the v60 -> v61 step loads with no program set;
- `file.rs` and `apply.rs` keep both version notes;
- the `program_info` round-trip test now requires v61 or later and checks that a v60 file opens with nothing set and no load note;
- the module doc and `docs/decisions/258-program-number.md` say v61.

**Other judgement calls:**
- `posting.rs`: #258's `program` module and #981's `program_unit` module now sit side by side. `run_program_with` takes `program_options(world)` (the post options plus `Units`) and the program id. `posting_mounts.rs` and `posting_per_op.rs` work the same way.
- `fanuc-lathe.cps` `onOpen`: #258's `progComment()` header line is kept, together with #1126's `G20`/`G21` unit word.
- The other .cps headers merged without conflicts. #258's per-dialect rules are unchanged: Fanuc, Fanuc Lathe and Mazak write O####; Haas writes a 5-digit O-word only when a number is set; Tormach writes no O-word (the number goes in the header comment); Heidenhain uses the name; SINUMERIK writes `%_N_..._MPF`. #981's unit handling is untouched. Heidenhain is still mm-only (`programUnits = "mm"`).
- `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md`: the `Units` paragraph comes first, then the `program` paragraph.
- New test `program_info::a_stated_identity_posts_the_same_header_in_an_inch_program`. In an inch program, Fanuc, Fanuc Lathe, Mazak, Haas, Tormach and SINUMERIK all write the same identity lines as in mm, followed by G20 (G700), never G21 (G710).
- Out of scope: `doosan-dnm.cps` still writes its O-word from `programNumber`. That value now carries the stated number, so a set number reaches it, but no comment does.

**Goldens:** none regenerated or changed. `PROCESS_VERSION` is unchanged (still 50), because #564 touches no process files.

**Gate (head 1676ad9e, debug):**
- **camcraft-app, all pass:**
  - program_info 10/10 (the 9 original tests plus the inch test)
  - conformance 6
  - golden_cl 30
  - program_units 7
  - units_migrate 5
  - project_roundtrip 73
  - mcp_units 2
  - mcp 20
  - posting 17
  - lathe_post_css 10
  - lathe_post_inch 6
- **camcraft-post:** all 14 `script_*` suites pass, 11 tests each except fanuc_lathe with 15.
- **ui:** `program_info` 2/2 (single-threaded, from `crates/ui`) and `structural` 9/9 pass.
- **clippy:** `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

The before/after screenshots of the Post page are in the PR description. I appended an update section there; the earlier text and the images are unchanged. **Ready for a delta review** (a merge of main plus one test commit).

**Delta review (M3) of the merge of main (#981, #1126) plus the inch pin: ready for the maintainer to merge.** There are no blockers.

**What looks good**
- **Project v61.** #981 keeps v60, and the program key steps v60 → v61 behind the existing settle rungs.
  - A v60 file opens with no program stated and no load note.
  - A bad hand-edited program value is refused as corrupt.
  - A v60 reader refuses a file that states a program.
- **Every post path calls `run_program_with`** with both `program_options` (the document unit) and a program id: the whole program (`posting.rs:531`), per-op files and per-mount files. No `run_with` or `run_numbered_with` call is left in the app crate.
- **fanuc-lathe** writes `%`, then the O-word with the comment, then `G20/G21 G18 G40 G80 G99`, which is a legal Fanuc-T order. doosan-dnm is unchanged.
- **Nothing else moved:** no goldens, snapshots, dependencies, build.rs, scripts or process files changed.

**Local results** (merged with main), all passing:
- post lib and all `script_*` suites;
- app: `conformance`, `golden_cl` 30, `project_roundtrip` 73, `program_info` 10, `program_units` 7, `units_migrate` 5, `per_op_files` 9, `setup_mounts_post` 8, `posting` 17, `lathe_post_inch` 6, and others;
- ui lib 654;
- clippy is clean.

**Mutations caught:** each of these makes a test fail:
- the lathe dropping the comment;
- the lathe always writing G21;
- the per-mount program id changed;
- `program_info_set` dropped;
- `PROJECT_VERSION` set back to 60.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- No test posts a stated program number through the per-mount path, so a follow-up test would pin it.
- The inch pin compares the inch header with the mm header. The comment's presence is pinned by `a_stated_number_and_comment_post_in_each_dialect`.
Merged. Release notes: the project file is v61 (older builds refuse it), so list this with the other format steps (#981 v60).
